title: Image Classifier: CNN vs Transfer Learning
blurb: Train a small CNN, then beat it with transfer learning, and prove it with error analysis.
brief: Pick an image dataset (CIFAR-10, a Kaggle dataset or your own photos). Train a small CNN from scratch with data augmentation, then fine-tune a pretrained backbone (for example ResNet or MobileNet) on the same split. Track training and validation curves, report accuracy per class with a confusion matrix, and study the misclassified images to explain what the model gets wrong.
requirements: A convolutional network with convolution and pooling layers
A data pipeline with train/validation/test splits and augmentation
A training loop with loss, optimizer and validation tracking
Transfer learning with a pretrained model (frozen backbone, then optional fine-tuning)
Per-class metrics and a confusion matrix
Saving and reloading the trained model, plus an error analysis of misclassified images
deliverables: A results table and curves comparing them
A predict script that classifies a new image
README with the dataset source and results
resume_bullet: Trained CNN and transfer-learning image classifiers with augmentation, comparing them with per-class metrics and error analysis.
